scenario: A buyer has a $100 ceiling for a gaming keyboard and is comparing a wired SK61 optical route, a wired Keychron K6 mechanical route, and paying more for an advertised 8000 Hz route. They require wired NKRO, prefer switch-replacement flexibility, and will pay a latency premium only when the frozen evidence establishes a product-specific benefit rather than a generic mechanism or owner impression.
target: Audit the frozen product bodies, rollover and polling mechanisms, optical-switch claims, and community uncertainty, then choose one route without treating a theoretical poll period, seller wording, or owner opinion as a measured product-specific or perceptible aim benefit.
